blocks.text: Respiratory pigments khoon ya tissues mein maujood khaas proteins hain jo poore jism mein oxygen pohanchane ka kaam karte hain. Yeh doosre kaam bhi karte hain, jaise O₂ jama (store) karna, CO₂ le jana, aur saans ki gases ke ilawa doosri cheezein le jana. Do mashhoor respiratory pigments haemoglobin aur myoglobin hain.

Haemoglobin RBCs mein maujood protein hai. Haemoglobin ka ek molecule chaar globin (gol, globular) polypeptide chains (do α aur do β) aur chaar haem groups se bana hai. α chain mein 141 aur β chain mein 146 amino acids hain. Har chain is tarah mudi hoti hai ke us mein ek jeb (pocket) banti hai jahan haem group judta hai; yun har chain ke saath ek haem hai. Haem group mein ek iron ion porphyrin ring ke beech pakda hota hai; iron ion porphyrin ring ke chaar nitrogen atoms se juda hota hai. Jab oxygen ka partial pressure zyada ho to iron ion ek O₂ molecule se jud jata hai. Is tarah haemoglobin ka ek molecule zyada se zyada chaar O₂ molecules le ja sakta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke iron ion “polypeptide chain ke chaar nitrogen atoms” se juda hai. Asal mein yeh chaar nitrogen atoms haem ke porphyrin ring ke hain, polypeptide chain ke nahi.

blocks.title: Chaaron chains kaise judi hain
blocks.text: Haemoglobin ki chaar polypeptide chains salt bridges, hydrogen bonds aur hydrophobic effect (pani se door rehne wale hisson ka aapas mein judna) se ek doosre se bandhi hain.

Myoglobin vertebrates ki skeletal aur cardiac (dil ki) muscle cells mein oxygen se judne wala protein hai. Yeh muscles ko surkh ya gehra surmai (dark gray) rang deta hai. Yeh monomer (akela unit) hai: is mein 153 amino acids ki ek polypeptide chain aur ek haem group hai. Is liye yeh sirf ek O₂ molecule se jud sakta hai. Myoglobin ki oxygen se affinity (pakad) haemoglobin se zyada hai, is liye yeh muscles mein oxygen jama karne wala protein hai. Jab oxygen ka partial pressure 20 mm Hg se kam ho jaye tab yeh oxygen chhodta hai. Is tarah zaroorat ke waqt myoglobin muscles ko oxygen deta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne myoglobin ki chain ko “polynucleotide chain” likha hai. Polynucleotides DNA aur RNA hain; 153 amino acids ki chain polypeptide chain hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: haemoglobin, chaar lipti hui polypeptide chains, oopar do beta aur neeche do alpha, har ek mein haem ki chhoti disc. Darmiyan: ek haem group bara kar ke, porphyrin ring jis ke chaar nitrogen wale rings beech ke iron (Fe) atom ko gherte hain aur Fe chaaron nitrogen se jura hai. Daen: myoglobin, ek hi lipti polypeptide chain aur ek haem. Teer dono proteins ke haem se bare haem group ki taraf jate hain.

blocks.prompt: Myoglobin oxygen ko haemoglobin se zyada mazbooti se kyun pakadta hai, is mein kya faida hai? Agar dono ki affinity ulat jaye to kya hoga?
blocks.explanation: Myoglobin oxygen ko zyada mazbooti se pakadta hai, is liye muscle se guzarne wale khoon ke haemoglobin se oxygen le kar jama kar leta hai, aur sakht kaam ke waqt jab muscle mein oxygen ka partial pressure 20 mm Hg se neeche jaye tabhi chhodta hai. Agar affinity ulat jaye to myoglobin haemoglobin se oxygen nahi le sakega, muscle ke paas koi zakheera nahi hoga, aur haemoglobin oxygen tissues ko dene ke bajaye pakde rakhega.

items: Respiratory pigments oxygen le jane wale proteins hain; yeh O₂ jama karna, CO₂ le jana aur doosri cheezein le jana bhi karte hain. Do mashhoor: haemoglobin aur myoglobin.
Haemoglobin: chaar globin chains (do α, 141 amino acids; do β, 146), chaar haem (har haem mein porphyrin ring ke beech iron ion), chaar O₂ tak le jata hai, PO₂ 60 mm Hg par oxygen chhodta hai.
Myoglobin: 153 amino acids ki ek polypeptide chain aur ek haem; zyada affinity se ek O₂; skeletal aur cardiac muscle mein oxygen jama karta hai; 20 mm Hg se neeche chhodta hai.
